# ScalabilityFaultToleranceTradeoff

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The design principle that as neuromorphic graph search scales to more cores, redundancy must be introduced to handle hardware faults without sacrificing search efficiency. Guides architecture decisions for reliable large-scale TCC systems where component failures are inevitable.
